facts.fact: StackAdapt's leadership culture article was published on August 22, 2024.
Five StackAdapt leaders are featured in the article: Vitaly Pecherskiy, Tishan Mills, Pinar Ozyetis, Anna Grodecka-Grad, and Andrew Norrie.
facts.quote: In this article, StackAdapt leaders Vitaly Pecherskiy, Tishan Mills, Pinar Ozyetis, Anna Grodecka-Grad, and Andrew Norrie discuss

facts.fact: Vitaly Pecherskiy is listed in the article as StackAdapt's CEO and Co-founder.
Andrew Norrie and teammates completed the 75 Hard challenge, which the article describes as a mental and physical discipline challenge.
facts.quote: when I and several teammates recently completed 75 Hard, which is a mental and physical discipline challenge

facts.fact: The article describes StackAdapt's leadership principles as including a "no failure" mindset, empathy, and transparency.
facts.quote: From adopting a “no failure” mindset to fostering empathy and transparency, they share the real-world impact of these tenets.
